objects.taxonomy_description: Composite flower with a central yellow disc surrounded by a single whorl of white ray petals (florets). The flower head measures 2-5 cm in diameter with 13-34 elongated white petals radiating outward from the bright yellow center. The petals are narrow, slightly pointed, and arranged in a flat, circular pattern. The flower is supported by a slender green stem with small alternate leaves. The center disc has a bumpy, granular texture from individual disc florets.

objects.taxonomy_description: A tall, long-necked ungulate with distinctive ossicones and a spotted coat pattern, distinguishable from other large herbivores by its extreme vertical proportions.

diagnostic_checkpoints.Neck_Length_Proportion: The neck is exceptionally elongated, appearing significantly longer than the torso and legs combined.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Cranial_Appendages: Two short, skin-covered bony protuberances (ossicones) are visible on the top of the head, distinct from antlers or horns.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Coat_Pattern: The body is covered in irregular, polygonal patches of dark color separated by lighter lines, rather than stripes or solid colors.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Leg_Structure: The forelegs are noticeably longer than the hindlegs, creating a sloping back profile from shoulders to rump.

objects.taxonomy_description: A medium-sized mammal characterized by a distinctive facial mask and ringed tail, distinguishable from similar carnivores by specific visual markers.

diagnostic_checkpoints.Facial_Markings: Presence of a prominent black mask around the eyes contrasting with lighter facial fur.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Tail_Pattern: Tail exhibits distinct alternating dark and light rings along its length.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Ear_Shape: Ears are rounded and relatively small compared to the head size, lacking the pointed tips seen in foxes.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Body_Posture: Stocky build with short legs and a plantigrade stance often visible when standing or walking.
